title: Portfolio Analysis
description: Access blockchain wallet data and analytics through Moralis APIs for portfolio tracking, token balances, and investment performance

portfolio_wallet_history.title: Wallet Transaction History
portfolio_wallet_history.description: Retrieve the full transaction history of a specified wallet address

portfolio_token_balances.title: Token Balances
portfolio_token_balances.description: Get token balances for a specific wallet address and their token prices in USD

portfolio_wallet_approvals.title: Wallet Approvals
portfolio_wallet_approvals.description: Retrieve active ERC20 token approvals for a specified wallet address

portfolio_wallet_swaps.title: Wallet Swaps
portfolio_wallet_swaps.description: Get all swap-related transactions (buy, sell) for a wallet address

portfolio_wallet_net_worth.title: Wallet Net Worth
portfolio_wallet_net_worth.description: Get the net worth of a wallet in USD across multiple chains

portfolio_wallet_profitability_summary.title: Wallet Profitability Summary
portfolio_wallet_profitability_summary.description: Retrieve a summary of wallet profitability

portfolio_wallet_profitability.title: Wallet Profitability Breakdown
portfolio_wallet_profitability.description: Retrieve detailed profitability breakdown for a wallet

portfolio_wallet_stats.title: Wallet Stats
portfolio_wallet_stats.description: Get statistical information about a wallet

portfolio_wallet_defi_positions.title: Wallet DeFi Positions
portfolio_wallet_defi_positions.description: Get the positions summary of a wallet address

portfolio_wallet_nfts.title: Wallet NFTs
portfolio_wallet_nfts.description: Get NFTs owned by a given wallet address
